purpose: The clone space for cloneable machines (localAssetStorageStack#8). Engines recognise cloneable machines when they load the corpus, by the rule in RealityEngine_CI SURFACE_SPEC.md (RealityEngine_CI#713); nothing is written into machine files. An engine clones one of them once per dispatch envelope, into one 64-cell block of this band, at the machine's initial state, and recycles the clone when its agentic action completes. scripts/cloneable_machines.py checks this file against the reserved range and reports which machines qualify.

block.note: The nest layout (owner, 2026-11-06): four uniform 16-cell quarters, the same in every block, so blocks are interchangeable. The clone's own input region starts the input quarter and its output region the output quarter; the cells its fanout folds into start the fanout quarter, in the template's edge order; its bus cells start the bus quarter. Offsets are relative to the block. Allocated when the clone is made and held unchanged until it is recycled.

slotRule: A machine fits a block when its input length <= the input quarter, its output length <= the output quarter, and the cells its fanout folds into (targetInputElements summed over its published-domain-bus-producer edges) <= the fanout quarter. Document-workflow handoffs carry the assetID and fold no cells. Its busCells always fit the bus quarter. n = folded fanout cells + busCells, as reported. A machine may opt out with metadata.cloneable: false.

band.note: 1024 blocks per engine instance, above the corpus footprint. Blocks are allocated by the engine, lowest free first, so engines with identical corpora place identical clones identically.

activeClones.note: The upper bound on active clones of one template on one engine instance. It is configurable and managed at run time through /api/engine/config; the band bounds the total.
